name: memory-graph
title: Memory Graph
description: Build, query, reconcile, verify, and deterministically export a private explicit-evidence causal graph across decisions, people, projects, causes, effects, and events.
whenToUse: Immediately after installation for per-agent direct-memory graph onboarding
An agent needs connected historical context across decisions, people, projects, causes, or changes that simple Memory Search cannot reconstruct

inspect.description: Parse and validate memory and return a bounded count/digest summary suitable for Gateway preview.

plan.description: Build a graph plan and return a bounded count/hash summary suitable for Gateway preview.

validate-plan.description: Validate a saved plan/snapshot and its deterministic hash.

validate-snapshot.description: Validate snapshot structure, invariants, and content hash.

validate-inference-candidates.description: Deterministically validate a bounded inference candidate bundle against a fresh explicit projection.

project-inference-overlay.description: Project a validated inferred-relation overlay and optionally reconcile its private mode-0600 cache.

onboard.description: Autonomously reconcile and verify only this agent's namespaced derived graph through a schema-verified direct Memory MCP backend.

cron-plan.description: Return an idempotent deterministic job name and a current Gateway cron.add agentTurn payload.

ontology-validate.description: Validate closed v0.8 assertion shapes against fresh canonical provenance.

review-queue.description: Return inert assertion, identity, and quarantine review queues.

cq-evaluate.description: Evaluate CQ1-CQ5 and deterministic assertion release gates.

semantic-view.description: Render semantic-first approved assertion views and hydration locators.

semantic-extractor-input.description: Select up to 20 canonical claims; optionally atomically persist the full bounded page beneath an approved private output root and return only path-safe metadata

semantic-validate-proposals.description: Validate supplied extractor proposals against exact fresh provenance; optionally persist full JSON privately and return metadata only

semantic-review-queue.description: Create deterministic inert semantic review queue; optionally persist full JSON privately and return metadata only

semantic-approve.description: Apply an explicit human approval manifest to validated proposals; optionally persist full JSON privately and return metadata only

semantic-build.description: Build approved-only semantic snapshot; optionally persist full JSON privately and return metadata only

semantic-migrate-v09.description: Read-only migration of sealed v0.9 semantic reports into inert v0.10 candidates

semantic-reconcile.description: Plan exact owned-only semantic reconciliation with resumable journal; optionally persist full JSON privately and return metadata only

semantic-export-html.description: Write deterministic fully offline interactive SVG HTML from validated inert candidates or an approved semantic snapshot

semantic-reconcile-verify.description: Verify a sealed semantic reconcile plan against a fresh post-dispatch backend view; fail closed while operations remain; optionally persist full JSON privately and return metadata only

semantic-decisions-by-person.description: List approved decisions explicitly attributed to a Person.

semantic-decision-why.description: List approved explicit causes for a Decision.

semantic-decision-impacts.description: List approved explicit effects and impacted projects for a Decision.

semantic-decision-evidence.description: Return complete approved decision evidence locators.

semantic-hydrate.description: Rehydrate decision query locators from fresh canonical source bytes.

semantic-seal-extraction.description: Seal a complete exhausted chain of lifecycle-aware bounded extractor pages before external-agent proposal authoring.
